name: model-flow
description: Open, web-based fate-and-transport and human health risk modeling (RISC5-class), with switchable legacy and modern methods.

scripts.docs:check: pnpm docs:generate && git diff --quiet -- docs/ATTRIBUTIONS.md docs/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md docs/VALIDATION.md packages/data/generated/validation/validation.json
scripts.data:generate: pnpm --filter @model-flow/data build:rsl && pnpm --filter @model-flow/data build:vapor && pnpm --filter @model-flow/data build:nrwqc && pnpm --filter @model-flow/data build:sediment && pnpm --filter @model-flow/data build:ecossl
scripts.gate: exec </dev/null; pnpm check:markers && pnpm lint && pnpm format && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm docs:check && pnpm data:check && pnpm build
